offering_description.value: Manufactures and sells branded cannabis products through licensed retailers, and owns and leases cultivation and production facilities to licensed cannabis operators in several US states. Also provides consulting to cannabis businesses.

primary_products.value: cannabis edibles; cannabis tinctures; cannabis flower; cannabis vape products; topicals

primary_services.value: licensing consulting; facility development advisory; compliance advisory

customer_segment.value: B2B: licensed cannabis dispensaries and operators leasing facilities or receiving consulting; B2C: adult consumers buying branded cannabis products at dispensaries

end_markets.value: cannabis; consumer wellness products; commercial real estate

revenue_model.value: product sales: branded cannabis products sold to dispensaries; rental or leasing: cultivation and production facilities leased to licensed operators; service fees: consulting and facility development services for cannabis businesses
revenue_model.category: product sales; rental or leasing; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: produces cannabis products in its own facilities, sold to dispensaries; brand owner: owns and markets consumer cannabis brands sold through licensed retailers; asset operator: owns cannabis facilities and leases them to licensed operators; service provider: provides consulting to cannabis businesses for fees
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; brand owner; asset operator; service provider

geography_served.value: US regional: Massachusetts, Illinois, Maryland, Delaware and other licensed cannabis states

specialization.value: related lines: branded cannabis products, facility leasing, cannabis consulting

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: licensed cannabis dispensaries carrying its brands; direct sales: facility tenants and consulting clients
